why: The founder's ruling of 28 October 2026, item 6: any sentence, Why? text or rationale that says or implies a cloud provider documents a behaviour carries the page's URL, the exact sentence quoted and the date read. The kit takes the shape of arvaken/mark's check (mark#914). A claim cites its entries by id, [source: id], in the README or in a comment or docstring, never in words a customer is shown. tests/test_provider_claims_name_their_source.py fails the build on a claim with no source.

fields.url: the page, https, on the provider's own host
fields.sentence: the sentence (or list, table row or entry) quoted whole, no ellipsis
fields.about: what the sentence is about, in the provider's own terms
fields.read: the day it was read, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)

owed.why: Claims on the kit's main branch when the check came: each is sourced by 4 November 2026, after which the build fails if any is left. The list only shrinks.
